title: Fix mkdir error 'File exists' and create a folder safely
summary: mkdir stops with 'File exists' when something with that name is already there. If it is a folder, you can use mkdir -p, which skips it without an error. If it is a file, choose another folder name.

aliases.text: mkdir cannot create directory file exists
why does mkdir say file exists
cannot create folder file exists linux
linux не могу создать папку file exists
mkdir -p создать папку если уже есть

steps.explain: Look at what already uses this name. A line starting with d is a folder. A line starting with - is a regular file, and mkdir cannot make a folder with that name.

placeholders.name: DIRECTORY
placeholders.description: The folder name you wanted to create

steps.expect: drwxr-xr-x ... projects means a folder already exists. -rw-r--r-- ... projects means a file has this name.

steps.explain: Create the folder safely. The -p option does not fail when the folder already exists, and it also creates missing parent folders. It still fails with 'File exists' if the name belongs to a file.

placeholders.name: DIRECTORY
placeholders.description: The folder name you wanted to create

steps.expect: No message means the folder exists now, whether it was created or was already there. If 'File exists' appears again, a file has this name: go to the next step.

alternatives.explain: Same as above, but prints a message when a new folder is created.

placeholders.name: DIRECTORY
placeholders.description: The folder name you wanted to create

alternatives.expect: mkdir: created directory 'projects' for a new folder. No message if the folder already existed.

steps.explain: Only if step 1 showed a file with this name: pick a folder name that is not used yet. Do not delete the file unless you know you do not need it.

placeholders.name: NEW_DIRECTORY
placeholders.description: A folder name that is not used yet

steps.expect: No message means the new folder was created.

verify.expect: A line starting with d and the folder name, for example drwxr-xr-x ... projects
